publicationAuthority: Public bodies require explicit per-record owner approval after privacy and rights review.
scope: Aggregate facts describe the complete local ChatGPT and Claude export index. Public records contain only explicitly approved projections; unreviewed source-derived titles, excerpts, signals, and bodies remain local.
boundaries: Automated redaction is a review aid, not proof of public safety or publication authority.
Unreviewed records never enter the public index, browse projection, sitemap, API body store, or static assets.
The curated Conversation Constellations are separately hand-written, privacy-safe paraphrases with source fingerprints.

selectionCriteria.localInclusion: All 1,386 unique export records remain counted in the local source index.
selectionCriteria.publicAdmission: Explicit per-record editorial, privacy, and rights approval is required.
selectionCriteria.indexability: Only approved public records can be considered for search indexing.
selectionCriteria.curatedLayer: Hand-written constellations remain public paraphrases and do not expose raw private transcripts.

aggregateDerivation: Sealed legacy manifest top-level fields and summary metadata only; no conversation body is copied into this projection.
